title: Enforcement Decree of the Korean Veterans Association Act
full_text:
Article 1 (Purpose)
The purpose of this Decree is to prescribe matters delegated by the Korean Veterans Association Act and matters necessary for its enforcement.

Article 2 (Detailed Criteria for Requesting Removal of Officers Without a Request for Corrective Measures)
Pursuant to the proviso to Article 19 (2) of the Korean Veterans Association Act (hereinafter referred to as the “Act”), removal of an officer may be requested without a request for corrective measures in any of the following cases:
1. Where it is clear that the matter cannot be corrected within the specified deadline even if a request for corrective measures is made;
2. Where a court judgment or an audit by the Minister of Patriots and Veterans Affairs has clearly established that an officer of the Korean Veterans Association under Article 2 (1) of the Act (hereinafter referred to as the “Association”) intentionally committed accounting fraud involving an amount equivalent to 1 percent or more of the Association’s assets in the Association’s accounting operations;
3. Where a court judgment or an audit by the Minister of Patriots and Veterans Affairs has clearly established that an officer of the Association committed embezzlement or breach of trust involving 10 million won or more in connection with the Association’s property or business.

Article 3 (Criteria for Imposition of Administrative Fines)
The criteria for imposing administrative fines under Article 22 (1) and (2) of the Act shall be as specified in the attached Table.

ADDENDA <Presidential Decree No. 34112, January 9, 2024>

Article 1 (Enforcement Date)
This Decree shall enter into force on January 12, 2024.

Article 2 (Applicability Concerning Detailed Criteria for Requesting Removal of Officers without Requesting Corrective Measures)
(1) Subparagraph 1 of Article 2 shall apply beginning with cases in which it is clear that an act of an officer occurring after this Decree enters into force cannot be corrected within the requested deadline even if corrective measures are requested.
(2) Subparagraphs 2 and 3 of Article 2 shall apply beginning with cases in which accounting fraud, embezzlement, or breach of trust by an officer occurring after this Decree enters into force is clearly established by a court judgment or an audit.
